campaign_name: AT-OPT-01 Runtime Cost Attribution and Routing Audit
purpose: Read-only audit of why PR-PLAY-79D-F3 sent one 22777-input primary narration, where tokens and latency actually go, and which single later experiment is justified.
executive_summary: Verdict B/PARTIAL. The F3 step-back was one gm.call_gpt primary_turn: 22777 input, 600 output, 23377 total, provider latency 5339.716 ms. Interpretation and the physical experiment were off, so the fast path stored operation unresolved, and disabling expression does not block primary narration. The 3000-token cycle cap was never installed; the HTTP script set 100000/200000 ceilings and admission allowed the estimate. The same sentence on the 79D-F host cost 72 tokens and was accepted. The F3 publication was a replaced fallback. Primary and retry calls dominate historical tokens; PR-PLAY-79 spent 131711 of 144968 tokens on five of them and published no narration. The captured prompt was not stored. A reconstruction puts the bulk in response_policy, instructions, and turn_packet. No production code changed. No live provider call. Do not start the recommended experiment automatically.

decisions_requiring_human_review: Review the B/PARTIAL verdict and the single recommended experiment before anyone starts AT-OPT-02.
Do not treat the reconstructed prompt section sizes as the captured token bill.
Do not set a 3000-token production cap on openings. Recorded openings are about 25294 input tokens.

missing_concepts: Pre-dispatch logging of the input estimate and per-section byte sizes, without prompt text.
A sent-versus-attempted counter so an unsent retry is not reported as a second provider call.
does_not_prove: It does not prove a safe deletion inside response_policy or instructions.
It does not prove that equal 25294 input counts are duplicate prompts.
It does not prove browser paint latency.
It does not prove exact accepted-line counts for 79A, 79B, or 79C beyond the handoff prose.
It does not implement a routing or budget change.
recommended_next_step: Do not start it automatically. One later experiment: if the fast path leaves a retreat unresolved, do not call gm.call_gpt. Keep the existing one-expression path when the physical experiment is already on. When it is off, return the existing non-mutating sentence and do not move position. A provider-free test must also show that a primary estimate over a 3000-token verification ceiling is refused before dispatch. Do not open PR-PLAY-80.
self_contained_review_test: The bundle contains the eight audit reports, the ledger summary, the prompt reconstruction sizes, provenance, and the coverage statement. No standardized gameplay evidence packet was produced because this cycle did not play.
